reviews.title: Second chapter made me quit
reviews.text:
I guess I chose wrong in chapter 2.  Game over because of my choice.  Looks like I need to pick a different option even if it’s not true to myself.  Weird therapy.

Okay.. so I went back to it even though it said game over.  It thawed me out and I started a new conversation and then finished the chapter.  I originally gave a two star rating but increased to four star now.  Maybe remove the Game Over to lessen confusion and frustration?

reviews.title: Highlights Things Missed In Therapy
reviews.text: The journeys this app take you on feel like interactive story time and yet every time I’m left with an aha moment or connection to childhood I’ve never made before.  I’m in my forties and have done a let of inner work and therapy.  The fact this app can uncover things I hadn’t realized before is amazing.  And it’s quick and fun.  When journey is like 10mins for me and I’m left with a wow.  I do one per week and let it sit in my system.

reviews.title: This should be required in every school. It's extraordinarily important for helping mental health.
reviews.text:
Betwixt took me on one of the most beautiful, strange, and transformative journeys I have ever experienced.

Every time I put on my headphones, I felt transported into another world. The sounds, storytelling, and dreamlike atmosphere were completely mesmerizing, but beneath all of that beauty was something much deeper. Betwixt led me into my own wounds, patterns, fears, and the reasons I sometimes struggle the way I do.

There were times I did not want to return because the dreams asked me to face things about myself that were difficult. But I kept going, and I am incredibly grateful that I did.

When I could no longer afford to continue, an anonymous donor paid for the rest of my journey. I may never know who that person was, but I hope they somehow know what their generosity meant to me. They gave me the chance to continue something that was genuinely helping me heal.

Because of that kindness, and because of the extraordinary people who created Betwixt, I came out of this experience feeling stronger, calmer, more confident, and more connected to myself.

It felt like stepping into my own NeverEnding Story and somehow finding my way back home to myself.

I hope one day this experience becomes accessible to everyone who needs it.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This is a truly moving, incredibly powerful experience. It has helped me so much, and I think everyone would benefit from it

reviews.title: Exquisite
reviews.text: Achingly beautiful

reviews.title: Enlightening
reviews.text: The detailed chronological story line captivates the subconscious and shakes very stubborn and outdated self beliefs out of place and puts them on trial confronting self with tender love and care. A well done inquisitive and introspective introduction to yourself. I found the app through their YouTube videos, I highly esteem both their public videos as well as the more intimate mythology of self and Jungian psychology of the app. 10/10

reviews.title: Lovely, enlightening, and beautiful
reviews.text: As a very self-aware, reflective person, I had my doubts that a silly “choose your own adventure” type story app would do anything for me. But I found it truly enlightening at times, the way it phrases things so simply yet digs deep into your roots with every question. If nothing else, it forces a sort of active meditation as you use the app that is at once relaxing and clarifying. I always come out of it feeling, if not at peace (because sometimes it forces you to confront unsettling aspects of yourself or your life), then definitely feeling more at one with myself and with a better understanding of who I am and why.

reviews.title: Hope is the Greatest Gift
reviews.text: Betwixt has given me something I struggled to find, the ability to be present in uncomfortableness while having hope that it is just happening right now. The ability to stop, recognize I am not in a good space and know that it is going to be different at a different point in time is amazing. The app helps me at work when I get really stressed. I can take a break, sit on a bench outside, and put my headphones on while I walk through a dream sequence. It reinforces to be in the moment and because there are choices available in the app, I am reminded I have choices in the moment. The sequences also help remind me that everything is changing all the time and this moment will change. I am very grateful for the app and also the videos on YouTube. I think this is the first review I have ever left and it is very heartfelt. I am so grateful I have access to the app!

reviews.title: Great for sorting yourself out some.
reviews.text: I wouldn’t say it replaces a therapist, but it’s game play creates a safe quiet space where you explore a few complexities. Great if feeling are a scary subject you don’t like to deal with directly as well.

reviews.title: Magical journey
reviews.text: Even though I’m a veteran of years of psychotherapy, Betwixt helped me in a brand new and largely unconscious way.  The pacing, the art and the way each step of the journey built on itself was brilliant.  I was the lucky participant of a sponsored trip and I couldn’t recommend it more highly.  Beautiful

reviews.title: A Wonderful, Engaging Way to Process Your Troubles
reviews.text: I process a lot of things narratively, and this app was exactly what I needed to work through some hard times and negative perceptions about myself. It has these really beautiful stories that are very comforting and engaging, and nudge you to dig into yourself at a pace you're comfortable with, so that you can process parts of your life and your thoughts and yourself. It helped me when I needed it, and I highly recommend it to anyone who is having a rough go of it and doesn't know where to start!

reviews.title: Very eye opening and insightful
reviews.text: Honestly I get really distracted and tend to not focus on meditations or exercises like these but Betwixt has held my attention like nothing else and has been incredibly helpful. Highly recommend and I’m very happy to have found it! The YouTube channel also is incredibly informative and I find myself returning to both this app and the videos often!

reviews.title: This app is priceless!
reviews.text: I love this app! It takes me out of my situation, the description of imagery is outstanding and the soundtrack is what really takes me away! After listening, I feel grounded and capable of handling the stress in my life. I do love this app! And each time you listen, it’s a different experience. I find myself looking forward to where it takes me!

reviews.title: Excellent for mental wellness
reviews.text: And self-growth!!! Loved it so much, and recommend to EVERYONE!!! ❣️🙏🏻

reviews.title: Beautifully insightful
reviews.text: I loved the different paths this mental journey can take you on. It def helped unlock some feelings I couldn’t put my finger on. Beautifully written storytelling that incorporated my life’s experiences as it asked personal questions to help me understand how to overcome some mental blocks. My only critique would be that they allow for a continuous flow rather than start back at the beginning but perhaps that’s just the current version. I hope they grow as well!

reviews.title: Soul stirring
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing, insightful in such inspiring ways. And the app has been very kind when I didn’t have the money to pay for a subscription. They continued to allow me to use the app 🙏🫂💗

reviews.title: Un-Stuck!
reviews.text: Edit to add: can’t use on iPad, works on my phone…I cannot review because I cannot get past the pages that say “why you’ll love Betwixt.” The pages lead nowhere, I’m not drawn into a dream/story, nor given the option to sign up. I’ve deleted/reinstalled, ensured my iOS is up to date, searched for advice, and am leaving this here as an SOS as your website doesn’t have a contact-us option… hoping to update review after I can experience the app!

reviews.title: So Cool!
reviews.text: This AI-free interactive story game has me gaining more insights than any meditation or self help regime I’ve tried. And I’ve tried a lot.

reviews.title: This is the real deal
reviews.text:
Go down the rabbit hole of your mind to find what you’re made of. Find ways to actively work inside your values for your own and the greater good. 
Bravo Hazel Gale!

reviews.title: Helped with my impulse control
reviews.text: With a price tag of $67 I was able to confidently say no.

reviews.title: You monster...
reviews.text: So it just skips the whole story if I don't want to talk about something? I didn't even know trying to describe my own self-sabotage would make me start panicking—well I think that shouldn't have happened in the first place. It tells of a monster...I think "The Voice" is the real monster...

reviews.title: Worth the time!
reviews.text: I was skeptical about any sort of journaling as that had just made me more sad in the past. Through using Betwixt, I was able to realize things about myself and my situation that I suppose I had always known and just didn’t believe. With only gentle prompts from the journal I was able to respond freely about my feelings or choose a premade response that somehow said exactly what I was already thinking. This has started to heal parts of me that I had turned my back on. I am hopeful and excited to use the skills I have learned from this experience to live a life that I deserve and can be happy in. Thank you Betwixt team for everything!! I am so grateful <3

reviews.title: I love it
reviews.text: Creators who care about their users, this app always calms me down and helps with improving my never ending thoughts. I recommend starting or ending your day with a chapter! As someone who is very anxious constantly it helps me come to a peace of mind

reviews.title: absolutely precious 💐💕
reviews.text: umm this almost made me cry, this was absolutely beautiful. I am so so happy and grateful! I am even more happy to support the team, the app, and the community in any way I can! I can’t wait to show this to my loved ones. This felt like the adventure in a bed time story but it feels like I entered it. 🌟 I can’t wait to continue on, I wish the team and supporters of the app all the best! 💕

reviews.title: In Love
reviews.text: This app is so calm and nice to do if I’m anxious or waiting for something. I recommend to anyone who wants to explore themselves in a fresh way!

reviews.title: No Collaboration
reviews.text: Fun until you try to put your own words in. Then they try to manipulate you with sentence starters and fail to honestly interact with what you contributed.

reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.text: Gently pushes me to grow at the pace that I need. I was super surprised that something like this would exist. I highly recommend it.

reviews.title: What a game!!!!!
reviews.text: Amazing!

reviews.title: Incredible for self-growth
reviews.text: Betwixt has been a creative way to explore myself in more depth during a rather difficult time in my life.

reviews.title: Eh
reviews.text: It’s alright, but nothing special or particularly useful. The app guides you through lessons where you can plug in responses but I didn’t find the questions very interesting or informative.

reviews.title: Good concept but…
reviews.text: I really appreciate that they made different avenues of pricing for people who want to experience it, people who can’t afford big payments. so far I like it but the messages you get seem to be very automated. It doesn’t feel like it’s personalized for what you say. It  kind of just gives a feeling that whatever you say or put the messages are already going to have a decision made, which makes it feel still and not truly unique to you. I think for some this is very fun but to me it felt a bit lifeless and stale but only because I’ve done my healing process for awhile

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Already on the third chapter and I’m crying good stuff very fun story

reviews.title: Good concept… but
reviews.text:
The AI backgrounds really take away from the app itself. It does not give a good first impression whatsoever. Cutting corners and avoiding paying artists isn’t something I’m going to support. It reads as cheap because it is. I downloaded and explored the app for a bit but honestly, it’s just ugly in my eyes.
(Also, ignore that other reviewer screaming about religion lol)

reviews.title: In LOVE
reviews.text: I just saw a video ad for this app last night and I am completely convinced this is the best app I have experienced in my life. I have been struggling with sleeping, relaxing and “getting out of my head” so to speak for awhile now. I began using this app and instantly I completely forgot about all of the stress and negative thought patterns and emotions I have been struggling to move past…I actually totally relaxed for the first time in a looooong time!! Whoever is responsible for creating this app::::: I appreciate you MORE than I am able to express!!! ✨✨✨give this app a try and I PROMISE it will NOT DISAPPOINT…. ♥️

reviews.title: love! Recent update is bugging…
reviews.text:
This is such a lovely app. Everything about it. I can’t wait to explore deeper however after the most recent update, the title screen is as far as I can get… 
I hope they fix it soon!

reviews.title: Betwixt
reviews.text: I think this is a GREAT WAY to explore yourself and your life and your feelings and dig deeper into your inner self and find out more about yourself I wish it didn’t cost SO MUCH to keep going because I would LOVE to continue to explore the story ALL THE WAY to the end and pay the 50 bucks to see what else I could do for myself because it’s fun and helpful

reviews.title: Uses AI
reviews.text:
I was so excited to use this app and have been sharing it with folks and just realized today it uses AI. I wish I could take my money back. It’s so disappointing that it’s not transparent but a hidden factor about the app/mental health game. 

It so easily doesn’t need to be. It could be programmed by an actual app engineer without using AI.

reviews.title: I absolutely love this app
reviews.text: I have tried many different apps for meditation but none works. But this app is amazing. It doesn’t even feel like you’re meditating. As well as working through some of your inner workings.

reviews.title: Entire app locked by pay wall
reviews.text: The app is free to download only but you can’t access any content unless you pay. Not sure why this app isn’t listed as paid app. Reviews saying the first 3 chapters must have been for previous versions

reviews.title: Worth Paying For
reviews.text: If you lack self-awareness or are unsure of the root of your struggles (like anxiety, depression, insecurity, anger, etc.), this app helps guide you beautifully through your own thought processes. You will uncover answers inside you that you had all along but couldn't access. Although the app didn't tell me much more than I already knew from years of therapy, it was such a positive experience to engage in and it had me in bittersweet tears when I finished. I did a replay as well so I could utilize the app for more than one struggle I have. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Overcharged
reviews.text: I chose a lower level ($19.xx) and it charged me $43.xx. It’s not cleared my account yet so I can’t dispute. This is ridiculous. I will not be recommending it to my clients.

reviews.title: AI art?
reviews.text:
I have to start with saying I so, so love this app. It’s genuinely brought me to tears and I think this idea is truly awesome.
That’s why I’m so upset about realizing what I believe is AI art on the cover of each chapter/dream. I know this company has enough money to hire an artist or purchase the copyright to a few images if needed. I love this app and I think it’s beautiful, but I’m disappointed.

reviews.title: Wanted to use :(
reviews.text: $200 :/ what the heck

reviews.title: Beautiful and calming
reviews.text: This is a beautiful app. It is so calming. I appreciate the intentional care they have clearly put into this app. As a therapist- I highly recommend to anyone who desires more presence, calm, and peace. It has been a source of clarifying rest for me. Thank you!

reviews.title: Words can’t do justice
reviews.text: I just began exploring, I plan to come back with updated feedback, I just have to say this is one of the coolest, surreal and profound experiences an app has ever brought to life.  I’m simply so grateful and intrigued to have stumbled upon this. I will be sharing with friends and family, without a doubt.  Tremendous effort and thought went into the creation of this. I’m so impressed.

reviews.title: Really helped, deeply meaningful.
reviews.text: I really loved this app. I completed it while doing some deep trauma work in therapy and it helped to soothe and supplement when I was alone at home. I still remember and hold tight some of the memories and visualizations gleaned. Thank you so much for this app!!

reviews.title: Spam emails
reviews.text: This app is interesting and I would have rated it higher if it weren’t for the fact that I have had to unsubscribe from multiple annoying email lists that I never wanted. Just because I download an app doesn’t mean I want to be subscribed to every blog post and thought of its creators. Yikes.

reviews.title: Sickeningly expensive
reviews.text: This game is ridiculously expensive. It costs $200 to unlock everything in the app. That is asinine and completely unnecessary! No simple app game should cost that much. Now you technically don’t have to spend $200. the lowest option they have is $20 but that barely gets you any of the features and is still really expensive for an app in my opinion. It’s worse too cause this game was advertised to me as a completely free experience, but it’s not. You can’t continue or finish the game unless you pay. That should be illegal. I’m so sick of app creators getting away with lying to and scamming their audience. It’s especially sickening considering this is supposed to be a mental health help app. So they’re intentionally praying on the emotionally unstable and nickel and diming them to death. If they actually wanted to help people they’d make a game that’s actually 100% free, or for a low cost upfront. But they’re just greedy evil people like everyone else. If you care at all about people don’t download this game

reviews.title: Needs more questions
reviews.text: It’s great but it needs more questions in the Infinite Dream. I already cycled through them all in just a few days.

reviews.title: I don’t normally review apps
reviews.text: I’m two dreams in and I can already say this has been immensely helpful in my emotional healing process. Won’t get into the weeds of my issues but boy was this the thing I needed right now in my journey. Found the app after discovering the YouTube channel. I’ll update this review if my feelings change but I’m hopeful that won’t happen.
